LESSON: FOOD IN OUR ENVIRONMENT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.3: Food in our Environment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Food in our Environment, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why do we have different food items in the locality?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Food in our Environment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: Self-awareness as learners find out the problems (overweight and underweight) associated with eating too much

or too little food.

Values:
Responsibility: Self-drive as learners observe good table manners when taking meals.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Health promotion issues: Learners develop the skill of eating clean and healthy foods as they choose food for personal well

being.

18

Link to other Learning Areas:

Creative Arts Activities: Skills of sorting and grouping as learners sort and group food items into food groups.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Approved learning support materials, adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features and software, foot-boards,

slates, Pictures/ Photographs/ plan for a nature corner/ charts with legible print and appropriate colour contrast on food items in

our environment, Adapted Pencils and crayons with enhanced grip, hand stabilizers, pencil grips, foot-boards,
